description: Assemble a bounded guide from project-authoritative event and property contracts with revision and ownership references.

guide.applicability: Use when the project Context Provider can return current reviewed field definitions and lineage.
guide.context_boundary: Field names and examples are not definitions; missing, stale or conflicting entries remain explicit gaps.
steps: Resolve the requested entity, event or property scope and current authoritative project revision.
Collect only reviewed cited definitions, bindings, units, sensitivity and effective ranges.
Return the bounded guide with conflicts and gaps; do not infer undocumented meaning or permission.
guide.title: Project field contract guide

summary: Expose reviewed field meanings and bindings without inferring semantics from names.
